headline: Apple posts a PMU Digital Mixed Signal Modeling role
fact: Apple posted PMU Digital Mixed Signal Modeling role 200659736, assigning SystemVerilog RNM, model-versus-schematic simulation, standalone validation, full-chip integration, reusable libraries, model accuracy metrics, regression and Python automation. The description states typical RNM closed-loop simulations exceed schematic speed by 100 times. Preferred experience includes LLM/AI-assisted coding for model or RTL development. This is a qualification signal, not an assigned AI model-generation workflow or independently verified speedup.
